name: City Council Special Meeting Budget Hearing
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Monday, June 18, 2018 - 05:00 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Sanchez
Roll Call
a.
Call Meeting to Order
2.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
3.
Presentation - Community Survey Discussion (No staff report)
4.
Update on the Public Works Director Recruitment
Presented by City Manager Smoot
ACTION: That the City Council:
1)
Direct the City Manager to hire an Interim Public Works Director (for a limited term; a 3-6 month period) and re-recruit for Public Works Director (with an increased higher salary - up to $160,000 annually); and
2)
Direct the City Manager to prepare a revised FY 2018-19 Salary Schedule resolution for the July 3, 2018 Council meeting.
Item #4
5.
Public hearing - Adoption of the Fiscal Year 2018-19 Budget
Presented by Administrative Services Director Kamada
Mayor to open the hearing.
ACTION: It is recommended by the City Council adopt the five attached resolutions for the complete implementation of the Fiscal Year 2018-19 Budget. The title of the resolutions are:
1)
City of Lomita's Annual Budget for Fiscal Year 2018-19
2)
Annual Investment Policy Statement
3)
Annual Appropriation
4)
Annual Full-time Annual Employee Compensation Plan
5)
Approve Class Specifications for Assistant City Manager, Administrative Analyst, Community & Economic Development Director, Human Resources Analyst, Management Analyst - Parks, Recreation Supervisor and Public Works Superintendent
6)
Annual Part-time and Temporary Employee Compensation Plan Res. 2018-17 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, adopting the City budget for the Fiscal Year commencing July 1, 2018 and ending June 30, 2019.
Res. 2018-18 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, adopting a Financial Investment Policy for Fiscal Year commenting July 1, 2018 and ending June 30, 2019.
Res. 2018-19 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, confirming the factors used for calculating the Annual Appropriation Limit for Fiscal Year commencing July 1, 2018 and ending June 30, 2019.
Item #5
6.
Consideration of canceling or rescheduling the July 3, 2018 Council Meeting - (Oral Report)
Presented by City Manager Smoot
ACTION: That the City Council consider cancelling or rescheduling the July 3, 2018 Council meeting.
7.
Adjournment That the meeting be adjourned to the next regular meeting to be held on Tuesday, June 19, 2018 at 6:30 p.m., Council Chambers of City Hall, located at 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in the City Hall lobby and bulletin board, and posted on the City's website not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. A copy of said Agenda is on file in the Office of the City Clerk.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
